description: This PHP source file defines a custom exception class 'PerformanceTrackerServiceException' within the OrangeHRM project's Performance module. The class is used to handle specific error conditions related to performance tracking and includes a method to generate an exception for a specific error case involving employee updates with existing review logs.

classes.name: PerformanceTrackerServiceException
classes.description: A custom exception class extending PHP's base Exception class, used for handling errors related to performance tracker services in the OrangeHRM application.

methods.name: cannotEditEmployeeWithLogs
methods.description: Static factory method that creates an instance of PerformanceTrackerServiceException with a message indicating that the employee cannot be updated due to existing review logs.

methods.name: cannotEditEmployeeWithLogs
methods.description: Creates and returns a new PerformanceTrackerServiceException with a specific message regarding employee update restrictions when review logs are present.
